name: gh-setup
description: One-time GitHub repo initialization: label SSOT sync, Projects v2 kanban board, docs/ tree scaffold, and ai-metrics footer backfill.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for the gh-setup skills.

The authoritative mapping is not in this repo. It lives in the sibling repo `dEitY719/harness-skills` at `references/kimi-tools.md` (https://github.com/dEitY719/harness-skills/blob/main/references/kimi-tools.md) and is the single source of truth for every repo in the `dEitY719/*-skills` family; do not copy it here. Summary:

- Read / Write / Edit / Bash / Grep / Glob keep their exposed Kimi names. Search contents with `Grep`; match paths with `Glob`. Every skill here is a thin wrapper around a `lib/*.sh` script or the `gh` CLI - run them with `Bash` and pass their output through verbatim; do not reimplement them.
- "Ask the user" -> `AskUserQuestion`. Two places need it: `gh-setup:kanban-bootstrap` asks once whether to hide the reserved columns when the repo looks personal (never infer this from the collaborator count), and `gh-setup:add-ai-metrics` asks `Continue with N cards? [y/N]:` before touching more than 100 cards.
- `TodoWrite` -> Kimi Code's `TodoList` tool.
- "Dispatch a subagent" -> `Agent` with `subagent_type: "coder"` (implementation) or `"explore"` (read-only). Never pass `general-purpose`.
- No skill here uses Claude Code's `Skill` tool or `WebFetch`. `gh-setup:kanban-bootstrap` reaches its sibling by running `skills/label-bootstrap/lib/label-bootstrap.sh` directly, which is a plain shell call and needs no skill-invocation tool.
- All four need an authenticated `gh` CLI. `gh-setup:kanban-bootstrap` additionally needs the `project` token scope (`gh auth refresh -h <host> -s project`) and carries `GH_HOST` on every call, because `--repo` alone names no server.

Safety contracts. These are part of the skills, not advice:

- `gh-setup:label-bootstrap` force-syncs the color and description of every SSOT label, and never deletes a label unless `--prune` is passed explicitly. `--dry-run` must make zero POST/PATCH/DELETE calls. The 10 labels, 3 alias renames, and 2 pipeline-state labels live only in `skills/label-bootstrap/references/gh-labels.md` - never hardcode a second copy.
- `gh-setup:kanban-bootstrap` always targets `origin` and never silently falls back to another remote. Never echo a token, a collaborator list, or a project ID to stdout. Never run the smoke test without an explicit `--with-smoke-test`.
- `gh-setup:docs-bootstrap` defaults to `--dry-run` and writes only on `--apply`. It never migrates a populated `docs/` and never overwrites `docs/README.md` without `--force`.
- `gh-setup:add-ai-metrics` is a backfill and is idempotent: a card already carrying an `<!-- ai-metrics -->` block is skipped, and bytes outside that block are never modified. Always pass `--repo`. Per-card failures are logged and the loop continues.

interface.longDescription: gh-setup bundles the four repo-initialization skills: label-bootstrap, kanban-bootstrap, docs-bootstrap, and add-ai-metrics.
